STYLE GUIDE (apply to every asset): Top-down 3/4 perspective pixel art for a 2D mystery/investigation game, readable cozy-clean classic farming/life-sim pixel style, dark atmospheric original foggy Victorian industrial occult world. Strict 16x16 pixel icons. Crisp hard edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, blur or gradients. 1px deep blue-grey #1a1c2c outline. Max 32 muted colors: slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, moss, rust, brass, bone; amber only lamps, turquoise #6fe0d0 or violet only occult. Flat 2-3 shades, top-left light. Transparent PNG background. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, signature, trophies or stars. No 3D, photorealism, painterly style or franchise references.
Produce one exact 10-column x 8-row atlas of 80 distinct achievement icons, equally spaced square cells no margins outside grid, transparent gaps. Render at 1600x1280 so each logical 16x16 icon pixel is a 10x10 square. Each motif centered in cell with 1 logical pixel transparent padding. Occupy about 12x12 logical pixels, intentionally very simple readable miniature objects. No grid lines or labels. Row order is binding:
Row 1: sealed folder, ink bottle, broken pocket watch, folded veil, photographic plate, music box, water jug, spool of thread, brass telescope, peat brick
Row 2: quarry chisel, printing type block, herbarium leaf, tide gauge, four wax seals, crossed out sheet, potion droplet, potion chain, potion root, potion eye
Row 3: potion claw, potion spiral, potion double halo, potion closed crown seal, folded claw, half full vial, empty goblet, ten notches seal, balance scale, chalk ring
Row 4: soot brush, hooded lantern, salt pouch, crossed mining tools, two linked rings, five folded letters, three closed shutters, returned parcel, mended broken clasp, signed quill pair
Row 5: open archive book, six book spines, rat specimen, moth specimen, stone jaw, ink beetle, thorn specimen, shell specimen, engraved tag, auction gavel
Row 6: paw print, furnished house, fog doorway, mail bundle, festival ribbon, three ribbons, unmarked shield folder, unmarked shield peat, unmarked shield stone, unmarked shield type
Row 7: unmarked shield leaf, unmarked shield shell, knotted nerve cord, discarded grey hood, broken grey mask, stack of shields, blank battle docket, cracked telescope lens, two different potion bottles, paw and feather
Row 8: paired shields 2, paired shields 3, paired shields 4, paired shields 5, paired shields 6, split ledger, bed and key, muddy boot, cloth and nameplate, corked final bottle

Paired shield variants use different simple embossed emblems (drop, chisel, type block, leaf, shell), never numbers. Potion variants use simple silhouette differences.

STYLE GUIDE (apply to every asset):
Top-down 3/4 perspective pixel art for a 2D mystery/investigation game, in the readable, cozy-clean style of classic farming/life-sim pixel games, but dark and atmospheric.
Setting: an original foggy Victorian-era industrial world with occult undertones: cobblestone streets, gas lamps, soot-stained brick, wrought iron, canals, chapels, secret societies, alchemical potions.
Grid: strict 16x16 pixel tiles. Overworld characters are 16x32 pixels per frame. Every pixel must align to the grid; no half pixels, no sub-pixel detail.
Pixels: crisp hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients; deliberate 2-tone checker dithering only on large surfaces or for fake transparency. 1px dark outline in deep blue-grey (around #1a1c2c, not pure black) on characters, props and icons; terrain tiles have no outline.
Palette: limited muted palette of max 32 colors, matching the existing game sprites. Desaturated slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, mossy greens, rust and brass, bone white; warm amber/yellow only for gas lamp light and candles; turquoise #6fe0d0 or deep violet reserved for occult/supernatural things. Avoid saturated primaries and pure black/white.
Lighting: flat base colors with 2-3 shade steps; light from top-left. Do not bake night darkness into sprites (the engine adds lighting).
Mood: melancholic, mysterious, slightly unsettling, never gory.
Output: transparent background (PNG with alpha) unless stated otherwise, orthographic, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
Avoid: 3D render look, painterly style, photorealism, chibi exaggeration, anime eyes, references to existing games, films or franchises.
Asset: ui/erfolge_rahmen.png. A single 48x48 logical pixel 9-slice Victorian case-file UI frame, enlarged to 768x768 with exact square pixels. Transparent central writing window. Outer 8px-wide border in slate, worn bone paper and muted brass. All four corners distinct tiny rivets. Top band includes one blank recessed round stamp space centered; middle horizontal edge tiles plain and repeatable; bottom band understated. No text. Frame outer bounds fill image, no exterior padding, no shadows. Include a very subtle 1px horizontal separator sample along the bottom edge that can be used as region. The window is fully transparent.

Asset ui/erfolge_stempel.png. One horizontal animation strip of SIX square 32x32 logical-pixel frames, entire image ratio 6:1. Same small Victorian wood-handled brass office seal/stamp in each transparent frame. Frame1 high near top, frame2 descending, frame3 descending lower, frame4 seal contacting lower baseline and two tiny ink specks, frame5 small rebound, frame6 stamped round wax impression remaining only. Keep same x center throughout, no crop, no extra objects. No letters or numbers on stamp.

Edit this exact 10-column 8-row achievement icon atlas. Preserve ALL 80 cell positions and all other icons unchanged. Only fix these motifs: row2 column2, row6 column10, row8 column3 have Roman numeral-like III marks: replace those marks with a single blank rectangular recessed metal printing block, with NO characters or bars resembling text or numerals. Row3 column7: change golden chalice into simple empty smoky-grey drinking glass, no handles or trophy look. Row3 column10: make chalk ring circular rather than eye/angular seal. Do not change grid, transparent background or canvas proportions. Keep all the other 75 icons.

postprocess: Extract 10 columns; alpha-gap row boundaries [0,154,297,438,583,722,865,996,1122]; Nearest Neighbor per-cell fit with >=1px padding
Quantize to shared 32-color palette, no dithering
Alpha threshold 200; remove isolated source fragments below 4% of largest connected component before cell fitting; zero RGB under transparent pixels
Open state: preserved silhouette, 1 logical pixel top-left highlight
